dataset_example.problem: The operation $\otimes$ is defined for all nonzero numbers by $a \otimes b = \frac{a^{2}}{b}$. Determine $[(1 \otimes 2) \otimes 3] - [1 \otimes (2 \otimes 3)]$.
dataset_example.solution:

   \[
